text: Remote training on the 4060 Ti (16 GB) via SSH; tiny inference locally

status.comment: Why now: on the laptop (15 GB RAM, swap 84% used) only ONE training fits at a time (earlyoom killed parallel runs twice on 2026-11-22); deep24 runs at ~5.5 s/it on CPU (4000 its ~ 6 h). Needed from Felix: SSH host/user for the 4060 Ti machine (key auth), with uv installed and CUDA drivers. Then I: (1) rsync train/ code + data/prepared/256to128-15min-native (2.6 GB) + nice-net, (2) add a train.device option (cuda) to train.py and verify on that GPU, (3) run deep24 / dropout / corridor A/Bs there in parallel, (4) rsync nets back. Exact ask: `ssh <user>@<host>` that works from this laptop.
